notes: Timeline = audio/mix.wav (the song: the mixdown of the seven supplied tracks). Tempo is constant: 119.995 BPM (period 0.50002 s), fitted over the whole cut on drum+mix onset envelopes, phase refined on kick attack times; first beat in the song 0.489 s. The grid starts on the song's first beat (a pickup); bar 0 starts on the next beat. First downbeat 0.989 s; bar k starts at first_downbeat + k*4*period. Envelopes: 100 fps, frame i centred at i/100 s, 46 ms RMS window, one-pole smoothing (10 ms attack / 90 ms release), each divided by its own 99th percentile and clipped to 0..1 (linear amplitude). low <150 Hz, mid 150-2000 Hz, high >4 kHz of the full mix; vocal/drums/bass/other = RMS of the supplied tracks (drums = kick+snare+kit, bass = rhythm, other = guitar+backing). Onsets [time, strength 0-1] from the tracks: kick = <120 Hz attacks of the kick track (320); snare = 1.5-5 kHz attacks of the snare track with a loud noise tail (108); hat = >7 kHz attacks of the kit track away from snares and kicks (288). vocal = onset-strength peaks of the vocal stem.
